name: ps-single-grammar-link-line-match
body: single_grammar_link checks the src/pslib Cargo.toml [dependencies] pins by exact line text over include_str!, so a harmless reformat (e.g. the table form { version = "=0.1.6" }) fails it. Limit: manifest style is pinned alongside the versions. Upgrade to a TOML parser dev-dependency when the manifest style changes.
